# StiQR - Smart QR Code Generator with Analytics & Tracking

> StiQR is a powerful, dynamic QR code generator platform designed for businesses, events, and personal use. It allows you to create visually stunning, trackable QR codes that can be updated in real-time without reprinting. Founded by Erik Night in 2026, StiQR is rapidly gaining traction with nearly 10,000 new users every month.

## Core Features

- **Dynamic QR Codes**: Change the destination URL or content anytime without regenerating the QR code. Perfect for updating menus, offers, or event details instantly.
- **Full Customization**: Design QR codes with custom colors, stickers, frames, and your own logo to make them stand out and reinforce your brand.
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Track every scan with detailed statistics, including location, device, and time, to understand your audience and measure campaign success.
- **Versatile Use Cases**: Create QR codes for:
    - **Restaurant Menus**: Update digital menus instantly without reprinting.
    - **Events**: Manage RSVPs, wedding galleries, seating plans, and real-time schedules for birthdays, weddings, and conferences.
    - **Marketing & Social Media**: Create redirecting pages for social media campaigns.
    - **Document Sharing**: Securely share PDFs and other documents via QR codes.
    - **Business Cards & Portfolios**: Link to your latest work or contact information.
- **No Coding Required**: Simple, intuitive interface for creating and managing QR codes.

## Pricing Plans

## Why StiQR?

StiQR is the solution for anyone tired of static, black-and-white QR codes. It offers a modern, branded, and data-driven approach to connecting the physical and digital worlds. With a focus on simplicity and powerful features, it helps businesses attract customers, streamline operations, and gain valuable insights.
